description.zh:
要查询的流量数据的结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instances to query.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:
要查询的流量数据的开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

title.zh: 查询DDoS高防受到的攻击带宽和包速峰值

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于查询指定时间段内DDoS高防受到的攻击带宽和包速峰值。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query the peak bandwidth and peak packet rate of attack traffic on one or more Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances within a specific period of time.

### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-port-attack-max-flow --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --end-time 1583683200 --start-time 1582992000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
